Apple seeks US approval for chips from blacklisted Chinese firm

Apple is reportedly seeking approval from the US government to purchase memory chips from a Chinese company that has been blacklisted due to alleged ties to the Chinese military. The company aims to source components from YMTC, a move that has drawn attention given the US government's stance on such entities. This situation highlights the complex geopolitical and economic factors influencing global supply chains.
